title: Iblis Refuses to Bow
imagePrompt: Rings of white-gold angelic light all bowing low at once in a sweeping wave, while one dark flame-like figure stays standing upright, its fire darkening from orange to deep crimson; the golden background giving way to storm-grey ink wash; a soft standing silhouette of light at the centre, seen from afar.

beats.say: Allah commanded the angels to bow before Adam.
Every ring of light bowed low at once, all but one.

verse.en: …so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He refused…

beats.say: Iblis stayed standing, and his fire darkened.

verse.en: What prevented you from prostrating when I commanded you?

beats.say: Pride had found its first voice.

verse.en: I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay.
